record.name: LinkedIn Ads
record.one_liner: The LinkedIn Marketing API Program offers public REST APIs utilizing OAuth 2.0 to create campaigns, report performance, manage leads, and grow company pages.

auth.notes: The LinkedIn API uses OAuth 2.0 for member (user) authorization and API authentication, supporting both 3-legged and 2-legged OAuth flows.

access.notes: Developers can get started by creating a developer application in the Developer Portal and applying for API access.
